name: Fictional USD wholesale banking portfolio
assumptions: All issuers, positions, valuations and sensitivities are fictional. This is not a customer portfolio.
Fair value is separate from principal/notional. Signed derivative fair values are included in the base total; notionals are not.
Cash rate and credit-spread changes use separate first-order modified-duration sensitivities, in years.
Floating loans have short rate reset sensitivity but retain credit-spread sensitivity.
Swaps use synthetic signed USD P&L per basis point: payer-fixed positive, receiver-fixed negative under a positive parallel rate shock.
Government bonds have no corporate credit-spread shock; swaps have no modeled credit/CVA shock.
Excluded: convexity, nonparallel curves, basis risk, FX, options, liquidity, default cash flows, recovery, funding costs and net interest income.
No additional default-loss overlay is added to spread losses. These are conditional illustrative fair-value changes, not forecasts or regulatory capital calculations.
